baseline: Five existing R71 original journal leads remain distinct from these three newly researched source leads.

sourceCases.reportTitle: ESSENCE: Phase 3 results and post hoc analysis, Neuromuscular Disorders 67 Supplement 1 abstract 2.67eP
sourceCases.sourceReportedObservation: Publisher abstract explicitly identifies NCT02500381 and describes ESSENCE phase 3 placebo comparison and post hoc analyses. Complete peer-reviewed original manuscript and signed prospective SAP are not independently captured.

sourceCases.reportTitle: MoonLake Q2 2026 issuer results update, with VELA-1 and VELA-2 study and estimand disclosures
sourceCases.sourceReportedObservation: Issuer lists exact NCT06411899 as VELA-1 and states its Week 16 HiSCR75 composite-strategy endpoint met reported statistical significance. No independent original statistical plan authentication or qualified effect/safety review is established.

sourceCases.reportTitle: MoonLake Q2 2026 issuer results update, with VELA-1 and VELA-2 study and estimand disclosures
sourceCases.sourceReportedObservation: Issuer lists exact NCT06411379 as VELA-2 and states its Week 16 HiSCR75 composite-strategy comparison did not reach reported significance (p=0.053). An independent SAP, estimand, multiplicity, safety and FDA review is outstanding.
